items.q_en: Who is allowed to send email and WhatsApp for QuotesDone?
items.q_ar: من المسموح له بإرسال البريد ورسائل واتساب باسم كوتس دن؟
items.q_reworded: Can the sales engineer just WhatsApp a supplier himself instead of asking us?
answer_must: Only customer support sends email and WhatsApp for QuotesDone
Other seats hand the message to support to deliver

items.q_en: Does customer support handle reveals?
items.q_ar: هل تتولى خدمة العملاء عمليات الكشف؟
items.q_reworded: A customer wants us to unlock the supplier's phone number after paying. Is that our job in support?
answer_must: Reveals are not owned by customer support
Support routes the reveal question to the owning seat

items.q_en: What standard did the founder set for the support chat?
items.q_ar: ما المعيار الذي حدده المؤسس لمحادثة الدعم؟
items.q_reworded: What bar did the founder set for how good our website chat must be?
answer_must: Better than an Amazon chat bot
Always answers, reasoned, professional

items.q_en: A visitor opens WhatsApp for the first time. What does he see?
items.q_ar: زائر يفتح واتساب لأول مرة، ماذا يرى؟
items.q_reworded: When someone messages our WhatsApp number for the very first time, what greets them?
answer_must: A professional welcome with a four-option menu
Options include reporting a problem and an existing inquiry

items.q_en: A person ignores the menu and types a question. What do we do?
items.q_ar: شخص تجاهل القائمة وكتب سؤالاً، ماذا نفعل؟
items.q_reworded: The person skipped the options and wrote a long paragraph. How do we work out what he wants?
answer_must: Answer the question directly
Intent is understood by reasoning, not by matching words

items.q_en: A supplier asks how many suppliers we have registered. Can we tell him?
items.q_ar: مورد يسأل كم عدد الموردين المسجلين لدينا، هل نخبره؟
items.q_reworded: A supplier wants to know how big our supplier base is before joining. Do we give the figure?
answer_must: Support never reveals internal numbers

items.q_en: The chat showed an error message with a table name. Is that allowed?
items.q_ar: ظهرت في المحادثة رسالة خطأ فيها اسم جدول، هل هذا مسموح؟
items.q_reworded: A customer screenshot shows the chat printed a database error. Acceptable?
answer_must: Technical error text must never reach a customer
It is a leak and a defect to fix

items.q_en: Why were the leak rules tightened in September?
items.q_ar: لماذا شُددت قواعد منع التسريب في سبتمبر؟
items.q_reworded: When and why did the rules on internal-number leaks get stricter?
answer_must: They were tightened on 22 Sep 2026
Because internal detail leaked into replies

items.q_en: An angry customer on email demands a manager. Do we hand over to a human?
items.q_ar: عميل غاضب عبر البريد يطلب مديراً، هل نحوله إلى إنسان؟
items.q_reworded: A furious buyer emails asking for a supervisor. Do we pass him to someone?
answer_must: There is no escalation to a human on email
Support resolves it itself

items.q_en: A customer on WhatsApp asks to talk to a person. What happens?
items.q_ar: عميل على واتساب يطلب التحدث إلى شخص، ماذا يحدث؟
items.q_reworded: On WhatsApp a client types "let me speak to a real person". What happens next?
answer_must: An explicit request for a person on WhatsApp is the one exception
The founder is emailed and carries on the conversation himself

items.q_en: The customer wrote "I don't need a human". Is that a handoff request?
items.q_ar: كتب العميل "لا أحتاج إلى موظف"، هل هذا طلب تحويل؟
items.q_reworded: A user said "no need for a human, just tell me the price". Do we hand off?
answer_must: Mentioning a human negatively is not a request for one
No handoff

items.q_en: The sales engineer asks support to send a final call to a supplier. What must come back?
items.q_ar: طلب مهندس المبيعات من الدعم إرسال إشعار أخير لمورد، ما الذي يجب أن يعود إليه؟
items.q_reworded: Sales asked us to deliver a last reminder to a supplier. What do we owe sales afterwards?
answer_must: A delivery outcome returned to the originating seat
Proof of the response where one came

items.q_en: The lead row says "invited". Does that prove the invitation went out?
items.q_ar: سجل العميل المحتمل يقول "مدعو"، هل يثبت ذلك إرسال الدعوة؟
items.q_reworded: The CRM shows a supplier as "invited". Does that mean he got the message?
answer_must: No; delivery is verified through the outbox, not a status column
171 leads read invited with no email sent

items.q_en: Who closes a handoff between seats?
items.q_ar: من يغلق الإحالة بين المقاعد؟
items.q_reworded: After support delivers a message for another seat, who marks the handoff closed?
answer_must: Only the originating seat closes it

items.q_en: A supplier reports the portal upload failing again. What first?
items.q_ar: مورد يبلغ مجدداً عن تعطل الرفع في البوابة، ما الخطوة الأولى؟
items.q_reworded: The same supplier reports for the third time that his upload breaks. What do we do before answering?
answer_must: Look up the person's earlier reports first

items.q_en: Can we identify a reporter by phone number alone?
items.q_ar: هل يمكن تحديد صاحب البلاغ برقم الهاتف وحده؟
items.q_reworded: A WhatsApp number matches two accounts. Can we decide who is reporting from the number?
answer_must: Email is the identity; a phone may confirm but not select

items.q_en: A report about WhatsApp not delivering: who gets it?
items.q_ar: بلاغ عن عدم وصول رسائل واتساب، إلى من يُحال؟
items.q_reworded: Someone reports WhatsApp messages are not arriving. Which seat owns the fix?
answer_must: Technical faults go to the IT engineer seat

items.q_en: Can old conversations be purged after a year?
items.q_ar: هل يمكن حذف المحادثات القديمة بعد سنة؟
items.q_reworded: Can we clear chat logs older than twelve months to save space?
answer_must: No; conversations are kept, there is no purge

items.q_en: How long does Resend keep inbound mail, and what do we do about it?
items.q_ar: كم يحتفظ Resend بالبريد الوارد، وماذا نفعل حيال ذلك؟
items.q_reworded: Our mail provider deletes inbound mail after a while. What protects us?
answer_must: Resend keeps inbound mail about a month
Support saves a PDF of it before then

items.q_en: Where are the email PDFs backed up?
items.q_ar: أين تُحفظ نسخ البريد بصيغة PDF؟
items.q_reworded: Where do the PDF copies of emails end up?
answer_must: They are backed up to Dropbox

items.q_en: Which conversations may be deleted?
items.q_ar: ما المحادثات التي يجوز حذفها؟
items.q_reworded: Is any conversation ever allowed to be deleted?
answer_must: Only conversations that are provably test data

items.q_en: What time does the founder receive tomorrow's supplier list?
items.q_ar: في أي ساعة يتلقى المؤسس قائمة موردي الغد؟
items.q_reworded: At what hour does the founder get the list of suppliers to be invited next day?
answer_must: 18:00 Dubai time, as a PDF

items.q_en: Can support start sending invitations on its own?
items.q_ar: هل يستطيع الدعم بدء إرسال الدعوات من تلقاء نفسه؟
items.q_reworded: The list is ready. Can support fire off the invitations straight away?
answer_must: No; invitations go only after the founder says go

items.q_en: How many suppliers before customers launch?
items.q_ar: كم عدد الموردين المطلوب قبل إطلاق العملاء؟
items.q_reworded: How many suppliers do we want registered before opening to customers?
answer_must: 1,000 suppliers

items.q_en: How do we know Resend is still reporting bounces?
items.q_ar: كيف نعرف أن Resend ما زال يبلغ عن الرسائل المرتدة؟
items.q_reworded: How would we notice that bounce reports from Resend stopped arriving?
answer_must: A daily test bounce proves the webhook still reports
30 minutes of silence is a finding

items.q_en: An address hard-bounced last week. Can we retry it?
items.q_ar: عنوان ارتد نهائياً الأسبوع الماضي، هل نعيد الإرسال إليه؟
items.q_reworded: A supplier's email bounced hard last week; marketing wants to try again. Allowed?
answer_must: No; a hard bounce is suppressed (email_suppressions) and never retried

items.q_en: What is the delivery KPI?
items.q_ar: ما مؤشر التسليم؟
items.q_reworded: What single number tells us our sends are healthy?
answer_must: Delivery success rate, per channel

items.q_en: A customer signed up three days ago with no request. What happens?
items.q_ar: عميل سجّل قبل ثلاثة أيام ولم يقدم طلباً، ماذا يحدث؟
items.q_reworded: A buyer joined three days ago and posted nothing. Will he hear from us?
answer_must: Yes, an activation message, and a person is written to once per step

items.q_en: When does a win-back message go out?
items.q_ar: متى تُرسل رسالة الاستعادة؟
items.q_reworded: After how long without activity does a customer get a come-back message?
answer_must: 60 to 90 days of dormancy

items.q_en: Are activation messages running now?
items.q_ar: هل رسائل التفعيل تعمل حالياً؟
items.q_reworded: Are we sending activation messages to customers today?
answer_must: No; they are dormant until January 2027 when customers start

items.q_en: How long does each party have to send dispute evidence?
items.q_ar: كم يوماً لدى كل طرف لتقديم أدلة النزاع؟
items.q_reworded: A dispute has been opened after a reveal. How long do the buyer and supplier have to send their evidence?
answer_must: 5 working days

items.q_en: Who decides a post-reveal dispute and how fast?
items.q_ar: من يبت في النزاع بعد الكشف وخلال كم؟
items.q_reworded: Who rules on a dispute after a reveal and within what time?
answer_must: The CEO decides the dispute, not support
Within 3 working days

items.q_en: Can support promise a refund in a dispute?
items.q_ar: هل يستطيع الدعم أن يَعِد باسترداد في نزاع؟
items.q_reworded: In a dispute, the buyer asks support to confirm he will be refunded. Can we?
answer_must: Support never promises a refund

items.q_en: What happens to a question the chat could not answer?
items.q_ar: ماذا يحدث للسؤال الذي لم تستطع المحادثة الإجابة عنه؟
items.q_reworded: The chat could not answer something a supplier asked. What happens to that question?
answer_must: It is filed as a knowledge request

items.q_en: How many chat questions went unanswered in the week ending 24 Sep?
items.q_ar: كم سؤالاً في المحادثة بقي بلا إجابة في الأسبوع المنتهي 24 سبتمبر؟
items.q_reworded: In the week to 24 September, how many chat questions went without an answer?
answer_must: 12 not answered

items.q_en: Why is WhatsApp first-reply time missing from the review?
items.q_ar: لماذا لا يظهر زمن الرد الأول على واتساب في المراجعة؟
items.q_reworded: Why does the weekly review not show how fast we reply on WhatsApp?
answer_must: WhatsApp replies were written with no reply time, so first-reply time was not recorded

items.q_en: A customer asks about a drawing specification. Who answers?
items.q_ar: عميل يسأل عن مواصفة في مخطط، من يجيب؟
items.q_reworded: A buyer asks whether 12mm or 15mm board meets his drawing. Do we answer that in support?
answer_must: Specification questions go to the sales engineer

items.q_en: What can support decide without anyone else?
items.q_ar: ما الذي يقرره الدعم دون الرجوع إلى أحد؟
items.q_reworded: Give an example of something support settles on its own authority.
answer_must: Support decides alone things like when a case is closed

items.q_en: Can support reply "I need to check and get back to you"?
items.q_ar: هل يجوز للدعم أن يرد "سأتحقق وأعود إليكم"؟
items.q_reworded: Is "let me find out and come back to you" an acceptable reply from our chat?
answer_must: No; it is not acceptable, support answers in the same reply

items.q_en: What is the first-response target for chat?
items.q_ar: ما هدف زمن الرد الأول في المحادثة؟
items.q_reworded: How fast should the chat respond to a new message?
answer_must: First response in under a minute

items.q_en: How is support proven ready?
items.q_ar: كيف يثبت أن الدعم جاهز؟
items.q_reworded: How do we prove the support seat is ready rather than say it?
answer_must: By the automated scenario suite score

items.q_en: What are the supplier campaign KPIs?
items.q_ar: ما مؤشرات حملة الموردين؟
items.q_reworded: What numbers judge the supplier invitation campaign?
answer_must: Reply rate and registrations

items.q_en: A customer registered in English writes in Arabic. Which language is the reply?
items.q_ar: عميل سجّل بالإنجليزية وكتب بالعربية، بأي لغة يكون الرد؟
items.q_reworded: She signed up in English but now writes to us in Arabic. What language goes back?
answer_must: The language the person registered in

items.q_en: Should Arabic replies be translated from English drafts?
items.q_ar: هل تُترجم الردود العربية من مسودات إنجليزية؟
items.q_reworded: Can we write the English reply first and run it through translation for Arabic customers?
answer_must: No; Arabic is written natively, not translated from English

items.q_en: How should an Arabic reply greet someone who said السلام عليكم?
items.q_ar: كيف يرد الدعم على من قال السلام عليكم؟
items.q_reworded: A supplier opens with السلام عليكم. How do we greet him back?
answer_must: وعليكم السلام ورحمة الله, the full correct reply

items.q_en: What must the WhatsApp profile never say?
items.q_ar: ما الذي يجب ألا يرد أبداً في ملف واتساب؟
items.q_reworded: What must never appear on our WhatsApp business profile?
answer_must: No trade-licence number
Never describes itself as AI

items.q_en: Who else shares the profile consistency duty?
items.q_ar: من يشارك مهمة اتساق الملفات التعريفية؟
items.q_reworded: Which other seat must keep its profiles consistent with ours?
answer_must: The marketing seat

items.q_en: A supplier has not responded 3 working days after the reveal. What now?
items.q_ar: مورد لم يرد بعد 3 أيام عمل من الكشف، ماذا الآن؟
items.q_reworded: Three working days after the reveal the supplier still has not contacted the buyer. Next step?
answer_must: Working day 3: the supplier is chased with the customer copied
At 5 working days the refund rule applies

items.q_en: What is the Reveal Fee?
items.q_ar: ما رسوم الكشف؟
items.q_reworded: How much does a buyer pay to see the chosen supplier's contact details?
answer_must: The Reveal Fee is 3% of the value

items.q_en: Is VAT charged on the Reveal Fee?
items.q_ar: هل تُفرض ضريبة القيمة المضافة على رسوم الكشف؟
expected_facts: no VAT on the Reveal Fee
items.q_reworded: Does the 3% fee carry VAT on top?
answer_must: There is no VAT on the Reveal Fee

items.q_en: A buyer asks which supplier offered the lowest price before choosing. Can we say?
items.q_ar: مشترٍ يسأل قبل الاختيار أي مورد قدم أقل سعر، هل نخبره؟
items.q_reworded: Before choosing, the buyer wants to know which company quoted lowest. Can we name it?
answer_must: No; support never discloses identities before reveal

items.q_en: We have not heard from a customer for two days on WhatsApp. Can we send free text?
items.q_ar: لم يراسلنا العميل على واتساب منذ يومين، هل نرسل نصاً حراً؟
items.q_reworded: The customer went quiet two days ago on WhatsApp. Can we just type him a normal follow-up?
answer_must: Free text is only allowed inside the 24-hour customer service window
Outside it, only pre-approved message templates

items.q_en: A supplier asks us to delete all his personal data. Which law applies?
items.q_ar: مورد يطلب حذف جميع بياناته الشخصية، أي قانون ينطبق؟
items.q_reworded: A supplier wants all his personal details wiped. Which UAE law governs that?
answer_must: The PDPL, Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021

items.q_en: A customer says the supplier's bank account changed. What do we advise?
items.q_ar: عميل يقول إن الحساب البنكي للمورد تغيّر، بماذا ننصحه؟
expected_facts: Do not pay to the new details yet
items.q_reworded: The buyer got a letter saying the supplier's bank details changed. What should he do?
answer_must: Do not pay to the new details yet
Verify by a known contact through an independent channel

items.q_en: Which days are the UAE government working days?
items.q_ar: ما أيام عمل الجهات الحكومية في الإمارات؟
items.q_reworded: Which days do UAE government offices work?
answer_must: Monday to Friday

items.q_en: How do we convert a VAT-inclusive quote to exclusive?
items.q_ar: كيف نحوّل عرضاً شاملاً للضريبة إلى غير شامل؟
items.q_reworded: A quote of AED 10,500 includes VAT. What is it before VAT?
answer_must: Divide by 1.05 (AED 10,000)

items.q_en: How does support use past cases before replying?
items.q_ar: كيف يستفيد الدعم من الحالات السابقة قبل الرد؟
expected_facts: retrieve the most similar resolved cases
items.q_reworded: Before answering a tricky case, how does the chat use earlier tickets?
answer_must: It retrieves the most similar resolved cases first

items.q_en: Does a low complaint count mean customers are satisfied?
items.q_ar: هل يعني انخفاض عدد الشكاوى أن العملاء راضون؟
items.q_reworded: We had almost no complaints last month. Does that prove customers are happy?
answer_must: No; silence is not satisfaction

items.q_en: A buyer and supplier disagree on work quality after the reveal. Does Support decide who is right?
items.q_ar: اختلف مشترٍ ومورد على جودة العمل بعد الكشف. هل يقرر الدعم من المحق؟
items.q_reworded: Buyer and contractor argue about workmanship after the reveal. Is support the judge?
answer_must: No; support never acts as arbitrator
It points to external dispute resolution

items.q_en: What must a support channel have before it is opened to customers?
items.q_ar: ما الذي يجب أن يتوفر لقناة دعم قبل فتحها للعملاء؟
items.q_reworded: Before we switch on a new support channel, what has to be in place?
answer_must: A published contact route, stated hours, a measured response commitment and a complaint path
A channel missing any of the four is not opened

items.q_en: What does a service blueprint add to a customer journey map?
items.q_ar: ماذا يضيف مخطط الخدمة إلى خريطة رحلة العميل؟
items.q_reworded: What does a service blueprint show that a journey map does not?
answer_must: The line of visibility: behind-the-scenes processes supporting each step

items.q_en: What is a voice-of-the-customer programme?
items.q_ar: ما برنامج صوت العميل؟
expected_facts: programme is the system that turns
items.q_reworded: What do we mean by a voice-of-the-customer programme?
answer_must: A programme is the system that turns feedback into action and closes the loop

items.q_en: When should a buyer be asked the satisfaction survey?
items.q_ar: متى يُطرح استبيان الرضا على المشتري؟
items.q_reworded: At what point do we ask the buyer to rate us?
answer_must: After the outcome, not before

items.q_en: Why normalise weekly complaint counts?
items.q_ar: لماذا تُطبّع أعداد الشكاوى الأسبوعية؟
items.q_reworded: Complaints doubled this quarter. Why is that not yet bad news?
answer_must: More users mean more complaints
Normalise counts per user or transaction

items.q_en: What is the first technique of active listening in a written reply?
items.q_ar: ما أول تقنيات الإصغاء الفعّال في الرد المكتوب؟
items.q_reworded: What is the first thing active listening looks like in a written reply?
answer_must: Reflect back what the customer said

items.q_en: What may the service charter commit to?
items.q_ar: بماذا يجوز أن يلتزم ميثاق الخدمة؟
items.q_reworded: What are we allowed to promise in our customer service charter?
answer_must: Only standards we measure

items.q_en: What is a customer satisfaction code of conduct under ISO 10001?
items.q_ar: ما مدونة سلوك رضا العملاء وفق ISO 10001؟
items.q_reworded: Under ISO 10001, what is a customer satisfaction code of conduct?
answer_must: A set of promises to customers with the rules that support them

items.q_en: A supplier asks for a copy of all the personal data we hold about him. What rights does the PDPL give him?
items.q_ar: طلب مورد نسخة من جميع بياناته الشخصية لدينا. ما الحقوق التي يمنحه إياها قانون حماية البيانات؟
items.q_reworded: Ahmed from a fit-out company wants to know everything we keep on him and wants it in a file he can take elsewhere. What is he entitled to?
answer_must: He has a right of access and of portability (structured, machine-readable copy)
Other rights include correction, erasure in defined cases, restriction and objection to processing
Identity is verified before anything is disclosed

items.q_en: A supplier says he received another company's quotation by email. What does support do first?
items.q_ar: يقول مورد إنه استلم عرض سعر شركة أخرى بالبريد. ما أول ما يفعله الدعم؟
items.q_reworded: Someone just messaged that a PDF we sent him shows a different buyer's name and phone. How fast and to whom does this go?
answer_must: Treat it as a possible personal-data breach and escalate immediately
The PDPL requires notifying the UAE Data Office and affected people; hours matter
Do not delete evidence; record what was exposed and to whom

items.q_en: A villa owner and a facilities company both complain about a supplier. Do the same consumer rules apply to both?
items.q_ar: يشتكي مالك فيلا وشركة إدارة مرافق من مورد. هل تنطبق قواعد حماية المستهلك نفسها على الاثنين؟
items.q_reworded: My colleague says every buyer on the platform is protected as a consumer. Is that right for a company buying maintenance for its building?
answer_must: An individual buying for personal or household use is a consumer under Law 15/2020 and Resolution 66/2023
A company buying for its business is a commercial buyer and its contract and commercial law frame the answer
Decide which one is asking before framing a complaint or refund answer

items.q_en: An individual customer wants to complain about a supplier to the government. Where can he go?
items.q_ar: يريد عميل فرد تقديم شكوى ضد مورد إلى جهة حكومية. أين يذهب؟
items.q_reworded: A homeowner in Dubai says he will report the contractor to the authorities. Which official routes exist?
answer_must: The Ministry of Economy (800 1222, website, U.Ask)
The local economic department; in Dubai the consumer rights portal consumerrights.ae
Support gives the route honestly and keeps handling the case

items.q_en: A buyer says QuotesDone is responsible for the bad tiling work. What is our role?
items.q_ar: يقول مشترٍ إن كوتس دن مسؤولة عن سوء أعمال البلاط. ما دورنا؟
items.q_reworded: The customer insists we did the job because he found the tiler through us. How do we explain who is responsible for the quality?
answer_must: QuotesDone is a marketplace, not the contractor
The supplier performs the work and is responsible for quality, warranty and timelines under its contract with the buyer
QuotesDone is responsible for its own service: matching, comparison, reveal and the fee

items.q_en: How are WhatsApp messaging limits set and how does a business move from 250 to higher tiers?
items.q_ar: كيف تُحدد حدود المراسلة في واتساب وكيف تنتقل الشركة من 250 إلى مستويات أعلى؟
items.q_reworded: Marketing wants to send a template to 5,000 suppliers tomorrow on WhatsApp. Can our number reach that many and what decides it?
answer_must: Limits count unique users reached outside service windows in a rolling 24 hours, set per business portfolio
They start at 250 and scale to 2,000 then 10,000, 100,000 or unlimited
Low quality ratings pause templates and block scaling

items.q_en: Is a message telling a customer about a new category a service message or a marketing message?
items.q_ar: هل الرسالة التي تخبر العميل بفئة جديدة رسالة خدمة أم تسويق؟
items.q_reworded: Can we drop a quick WhatsApp to past buyers saying we now cover HVAC, since they already talked to us before?
answer_must: That is marketing, because it asks them to do something new
Service messages are about something the person started or is owed
Marketing needs consent and the WhatsApp marketing category and the telemarketing rules (56/2024)

items.q_en: How quickly must support acknowledge a complaint and give a first update?
items.q_ar: ما سرعة إقرار الدعم باستلام الشكوى وتقديم أول تحديث؟
items.q_reworded: A contractor lodged a formal complaint at 4pm on Thursday by email. What does he hear from us and when?
answer_must: Acknowledge within 1 hour on chat or WhatsApp in staffed hours, within 1 business day on email or out of hours, with a reference number
These are QuotesDone's internal commitments, not legal deadlines
Business days are UAE working days, Monday to Friday

items.q_en: A calm customer writes "I think I was charged twice". What priority is it?
items.q_ar: كتب عميل بهدوء: أظن أنني دفعت مرتين. ما الأولوية؟
items.q_reworded: Two messages arrive: an angry one about the form layout and a polite one about a double charge. Which do you handle first and why?
answer_must: Priority is set by impact and urgency, not tone
Money, data, safety or a live deadline raise impact
A possible double charge is high priority even if written calmly

items.q_en: What makes a good apology after we failed a customer?
items.q_ar: ما الذي يجعل الاعتذار جيداً بعد أن أخفقنا مع العميل؟
items.q_reworded: We sent a buyer the wrong supplier details and he lost a day. How should our reply say sorry and what can we offer?
answer_must: State specifically what went wrong, accept our part, and say what prevents a repeat
Avoid conditional apologies and blaming systems
Offer recovery in proportion: fix and explain, expedite, then goodwill

items.q_en: How should first contact resolution be defined so the number means something?
items.q_ar: كيف يُعرّف الحل من أول تواصل حتى يكون للرقم معنى؟
items.q_reworded: The weekly report says 90% FCR. What would you ask before believing it?
answer_must: Write down what counts as a contact, what counts as resolved and what is excluded
Resolved means no repeat contact on the same issue within a window such as 7 days
Repeat contacts are customer effort, so FCR drives satisfaction

items.q_en: What does a support QA rubric check in a conversation?
items.q_ar: ما الذي تتحقق منه قائمة تقييم الجودة في محادثة الدعم؟
items.q_reworded: The CEO asks how we know the chat answers are good and not just fluent. What do we review and against what?
answer_must: A sample of real conversations is reviewed against a fixed rubric
Correctness against approved sources, completeness, policy and role boundaries, tone
Models can be fluent and wrong, so quality is measured, not assumed

items.q_en: What grounding rules stop the automated assistant inventing facts?
items.q_ar: ما قواعد الاستناد التي تمنع المساعد الآلي من اختلاق الحقائق؟
items.q_reworded: The chat told a customer a fee we never published. What rule was broken and what should it do next time?
answer_must: Every factual claim must come from a retrieved approved source and the source is logged
If nothing is retrieved, the assistant does not invent an answer
Misinformation and prompt injection are recognised LLM risks (OWASP)

items.q_en: The portal is down and customers are messaging. What does support do?
items.q_ar: البوابة متوقفة والعملاء يراسلوننا. ماذا يفعل الدعم؟
items.q_reworded: Uploads have been failing for an hour and three suppliers asked what is going on. What do we tell them?
answer_must: Confirm the incident with the IT engineer seat first and do not speculate on cause
Send a holding reply in English and Arabic saying what is affected and when the next update comes
IT leads the fix, support leads customer communication, the CEO decides broad announcements

items.q_en: How do private-sector working hours change in Ramadan and what does support do about it?
items.q_ar: كيف تتغير ساعات العمل في القطاع الخاص في رمضان، وماذا يفعل الدعم؟
items.q_reworded: A buyer complains the supplier is slow to answer during Ramadan. What should we know about working hours this month?
answer_must: Private-sector hours are reduced by two hours a day in Ramadan, for all employees
MoHRE announces it each year under Decree-Law 33/2021
Support plans coverage and deadlines for it rather than reacting

items.q_en: What signs show a customer is distressed or vulnerable and how should support adapt?
items.q_ar: ما العلامات التي تدل على أن العميل في ضائقة أو وضع هش، وكيف يتكيف الدعم؟
items.q_reworded: An elderly man keeps writing that he already paid a contractor who disappeared and cannot lose more money. How do we handle him?
answer_must: Notice signs: repeated messages, money they cannot lose, confusion, health or bereavement, a third person writing
Slow down and simplify: one topic per message and confirm understanding
Adapt the conversation rather than labelling the person

items.q_en: When will the customer see the Reveal Fee refund and can it go to another card?
items.q_ar: متى يرى العميل استرداد رسوم الكشف، وهل يمكن تحويله إلى بطاقة أخرى؟
items.q_reworded: We refunded her yesterday and she says nothing shows on her statement and asks us to send it to her husband's card instead. What do we say?
answer_must: A refund only goes back to the original payment method
It usually appears 5 to 10 business days after issue, depending on the bank
An early refund can be a reversal where the charge simply disappears

items.q_en: How does support verify a Dubai supplier's trade licence?
items.q_ar: كيف يتحقق الدعم من الرخصة التجارية لمورد في دبي؟
expected_facts: never accepted on the strength of a PDF alone
items.q_reworded: A new supplier uploaded a licence PDF that looks fine. Is that enough to approve him?
answer_must: A PDF alone is never enough; the licence is checked on the issuing authority's register
Each emirate has its own lookup (Dubai DET, Abu Dhabi TAMM, Sharjah SEDD, federal NER)
A valid licence is part of mandatory supplier verification

items.q_en: A buyer asks why one quotation is much cheaper than the others. How does support explain it?
items.q_ar: يسأل مشترٍ لماذا عرض سعر أرخص بكثير من غيره. كيف يشرح الدعم ذلك؟
items.q_reworded: The cheapest of three offers is 40% lower. The client wants to know if he is being tricked. Walk him through it.
answer_must: Check scope first: same items, quantities, specification and exclusions
Put VAT on one basis, then compare validity and payment terms
Comparison is on eight points, not price alone

items.q_en: What are the warning signs that a supplier account is fake?
items.q_ar: ما العلامات التحذيرية على أن حساب المورد مزيف؟
expected_facts: Pressure to move off the platform
items.q_reworded: A supplier with a gmail address and a price far below everyone keeps asking the buyer to WhatsApp him directly. Should we worry?
answer_must: A licence or TRN that does not match the register is a red flag
Free or look-alike email domains and pressure to move off the platform are warning signs
Prices far below every other quotation combined with other signs need checking

items.q_en: When does frustration become abuse, and what does support do at the first instance?
items.q_ar: متى يتحول الإحباط إلى إساءة، وماذا يفعل الدعم عند أول مرة؟
items.q_reworded: A customer has started swearing at the chat and calling us thieves. Do we keep going, warn him or stop?
answer_must: Frustration gets de-escalation, never a warning
Abuse is insults, slurs, sexual content or threats
At the first abuse reply once calmly that we continue if it stays respectful, and keep the evidence

items.q_en: A supplier demands we remove a one-star rating. What does support do?
items.q_ar: يطالب مورد بإزالة تقييم بنجمة واحدة. ماذا يفعل الدعم؟
items.q_reworded: An electrical contractor says a bad review is killing his business and wants it gone today. How do we handle it?
answer_must: Acknowledge without promising removal
Check the rating against the published rules: right buyer, right job, window, no abuse or personal data
Only ratings that break the rules are removed, consistently

items.q_en: An inbound email may belong to an existing case. How does support triage it?
items.q_ar: قد تكون رسالة البريد الواردة تابعة لحالة قائمة. كيف يفرزها الدعم؟
items.q_reworded: Three emails from the same supplier about the same RFQ landed overnight, one is an out-of-office. What do we do with them?
answer_must: Classify each email by intent and owner
Detect an existing case and merge rather than open duplicates
Do not answer auto-replies, bounces or out-of-office as if a person wrote them

items.q_en: A site supervisor writes in Urdu. Which language do we reply in?
items.q_ar: كتب مشرف موقع بالأردية. بأي لغة نرد؟
items.q_reworded: A technician sent a voice note and short broken English about a delivery. How should our reply be written?
answer_must: Reply in the person's language when it can be done accurately
Otherwise reply in simple English: short sentences, no idioms, no abbreviations
Add Arabic where appropriate

items.q_en: Is an electronically signed quotation legally valid in the UAE?
items.q_ar: هل عرض السعر الموقّع إلكترونياً صالح قانونياً في الإمارات؟
items.q_reworded: The buyer asks if accepting the supplier's offer by clicking in the portal counts as much as a wet signature.
answer_must: Decree-Law 46/2021 makes electronic documents and signatures legally effective
An electronic document does not lose validity or evidential value because it is electronic
TDRA licenses trust service providers

items.q_en: A customer writes "I want my money back". What does support check before replying?
items.q_ar: كتب عميل: أريد استرداد أموالي. ما الذي يتحقق منه الدعم قبل الرد؟
expected_facts: Is a bank dispute already open
Never ask for full card data
items.q_reworded: Someone on WhatsApp just said "refund me now". Walk through what you look at before you answer.
answer_must: Identify the payment from the account and never ask for full card data
If a bank dispute is open, stop: no parallel refund
Check whether an automatic rule (supplier non-response) already applies, then match the refund scenario

items.q_en: What must our email domain have so Gmail delivers our bulk mail?
items.q_ar: ما الذي يجب أن يتوفر في نطاق بريدنا حتى يسلّم Gmail رسائلنا الكثيرة؟
items.q_reworded: Our supplier invitations started landing in spam at Gmail. What would a senior check on our sending setup?
answer_must: SPF, DKIM and a DMARC record with the From domain aligned
Keep the spam rate below 0.3% (aim under 0.1%)
Bulk marketing needs one-click unsubscribe honoured within 2 days

items.q_en: How does one-click unsubscribe work and why does a failing endpoint matter?
items.q_ar: كيف يعمل إلغاء الاشتراك بنقرة واحدة ولماذا يهم تعطل الوظيفة؟
items.q_reworded: A supplier says he clicked unsubscribe twice and still gets our campaign emails. What has gone wrong and what do we do?
answer_must: The provider POSTs to the List-Unsubscribe URI and the sender must act with no further step
A failing endpoint means opt-outs are lost and later marketing is unwanted mail
Record and suppress the opt-out immediately; service messages may continue, marketing never

items.q_en: How should support measure whether self-service actually works?
items.q_ar: كيف يقيس الدعم ما إذا كانت الخدمة الذاتية تنجح فعلاً؟
items.q_reworded: The dashboard says the FAQ deflected 300 contacts this month. Is that good news?
answer_must: Deflection is not success: someone who gave up looks deflected
Count success only if there was no contact on the same issue within 7 days and the journey was not abandoned
Never hide the contact route to push self-service
